source: Native AWS SDK calls; scripts/aws/aws_cli.py reused for identity guard; scripts/aws/signed_requests.py inspected, custom signing unnecessary for modeled SDK operations. SDK raw event generator observed without changing iteration, framing, parsing or connection behavior.
documentationObservations: SubscribeToShard documentation says subscriptions deliver events for up to five minutes, then require another call to renew.
SubscribeToShardEvent.Success documentation says emitted every time an event is published successfully while subscription active. It does not explicitly document a zero-valued sample for natural EOF.
Botocore Config documentation: total_max_attempts includes initial request, so 1 means no retries. read_timeout is time allowed reading from a connection.

subscriptionSchedule.rationale: Start at :10 and :35 away from minute boundaries; separate consumer dimensions isolate each terminal bucket.

analysis.finding: Both independent subscriptions ended at natural SDK iterator EOF after about five minutes with one actual admission attempt and no exception or reconnect. For both consumers, final terminal-minute Success has one extra zero-valued sample beyond decoded frames; Bytes, Records and MillisBehindLatest have only frame-matching samples. Initial and full minutes have Success=1 per decoded frame. Thus the terminal zero reproduced in both trials; these observations support this transition in this empty-stream setting, not a universal rule for every natural EOF.
analysis.publicationLag: Consumer b immediate terminal Success snapshot was count6/sum6/min1/max1, then count8/sum7/min0/max1 by EOF+120s. All five queried metrics for both consumers are unchanged across +120/+300/+600/+900s rechecks.
uncertainty: Two trials on one newly-created empty shard, two distinct consumers, one account/region and one boto3/botocore configuration; no claim of universal behavior across other transports, traffic or regions.
CloudWatch aggregates minute buckets; timestamps cannot establish the exact internal emission instant or causal mechanism of the extra zero sample.
No exception/error event or extra data frame was decoded for the terminal zero; raw SDK frame headers and payloads are retained. HTTP/TLS packet traces were not captured.
The primary Success metric documentation does not explicitly specify natural-EOF zero samples. No fabricated expected values are included.
analysis.clock: UTC capture wall clock plus monotonic elapsed seconds; native SDK CloudWatch timestamps preserve their returned timezone offset.
